## **Precio y paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Precio y paywall.**
      3 reseñas recientes mencionan precio y paywall.
      Ventana de reseñas: 28 jun 2026 - 11 ago 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Mencionan precio, suscripciones o paywalls. Puede señalar sensibilidad al pricing en el nicho.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Kaka hindustan gamer_, 11 ago 2026, 1/5: "I'm a free user, I delete this app due to paywall because can't work for analyse my weekly tracker & monthly widgets & still the main feature of the app habit tracker is not work because you have to pay for this"
            2. _Sushil Jaiswar_, 14 jul 2026, 5/5: "it's totally free guys! you can go for it. this is best habit tracker app for beginner who can't afford expensive premium membership and it will also remind you 👌 you can create multiple habits on it without any expenses like other app 🤝"
            3. _Tanvir Sadid_, 7 jul 2026, 5/5: "Very Friendly. But premium subscription are so expensive."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Presión publicitaria** {#theme-ads}

<!--ir-theme:ads-->
   **Presión publicitaria.**
      3 reseñas recientes mencionan presión publicitaria.
      Ventana de reseñas: 8 sept 2026 - 15 sept 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios notan presión publicitaria. Señala fricción de monetización y una apertura para un competidor más limpio.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Vishal_, 8 sept 2026, 4/5: "Most habit tracker apps today are packed with useless, flashy features designed just to consume your screen time and push more ads. This app is refreshingly simple, straight to the point, and keeps the focus entirely on tracking habits without clutter. The only major missing piece is a home screen widget. Having a 24/7 reminder directly on the screen makes a huge difference — it keeps habits front of mind and prevents the need to open the phone, which often leads to getting distracted by other a"
            2. _Khulicias Mdudo_, 15 sept 2026, 5/5: "This app is great it's made planning goals and building better habits easier however there are too many ads .I strongly recommend this"
            3. _Abhijith John Lambert_, 8 sept 2026, 5/5: "after so many researchers about a best habit tracker app, I finally found this app. everything is good in this app except ads. But there's a premium subscription plan for blocking ads"
<!--/ir-theme-->
